package.name: physx_vendor
package.description: Vendor package that builds and installs the NVIDIA PhysX SDK (https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse/PhysX) so that downstream packages can depend on it through find_package(physx_vendor). Exposes PHYSX_SDK_DIR / PHYSX_LIB_DIR pointing at the installed SDK (headers, static libraries and the vehicle snippet sources).
